subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this issue remain a separate proof gate for restart-free WhatsApp 515 finalization, or should maintainers fold it into the phone-code login PR once that PR lands?
rationale: The code path is auth/session-sensitive and overlaps a new public channel-auth method plus persisted credential readiness; the correct boundary is a maintainer product/API decision, not a read-only cleanup close.

options.title: Keep Separate Until Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a merged WhatsApp fix shows live QR or phone-code pairing reaches healthy connected status without a manual gateway restart.

options.title: Fold Into Phone-Code PR
options.body: Require the active phone-code PR to add the restart-free 515 proof and then close this issue only when that PR merges.

options.title: Treat Manual Restart As Workaround
options.body: Decide that the manual gateway restart is acceptable for phone-code recovery and close this only after documenting that operator workflow.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Until Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a merged WhatsApp fix shows live QR or phone-code pairing reaches healthy connected status without a manual gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses public CLI, plugin auth adapter, WhatsApp auth state, and setup/recovery UX boundaries where current-main blame and prior review routing point to steipete.
